title: Add a form or booking calendar to a page
blurb: Capture leads or take bookings straight from your funnel or website.

steps.title: Open Funnels
steps.body: Click **Funnels**, or **Websites** if the page is on your website.

steps.title: Open the page
steps.body: Open your funnel, pick the step and click **Edit** to open the builder.
steps.tip: Build the form in **Sites** > **Forms** first, and the calendar in **Calendars**, so they are ready to pick.

steps.title: Drop in a form
steps.body: In the elements list on the left, find **Form** and drag it onto the page. In the right panel, choose which of your forms it shows.

steps.title: Or drop in a calendar
steps.body: For bookings, drag the **Calendar** element onto the page instead, then choose which calendar it shows in the right panel.

steps.title: Test it
steps.body: Click **Save**, then **Preview**. Fill in the form or make a test booking. It should land in **Contacts** within a minute.
steps.tip: Send new leads an instant reply with a workflow that starts on form submitted or appointment booked.
